confirmed.claim: MqttRawLink 只在 send() 前檢查 connected（mqtt.rs:169-174），沒有覆寫 send_before，DeviceLink::command 帶的 deadline（protocol.rs:559-563）進不了 rumqttc；而 rumqttc 0.24 的 EventLoop::poll 在任何連線錯誤時呼叫 clean()，把 state.clean()（所有已送出但未收到 PubAck 的 QoS1 Publish）與 requests_rx.drain()（尚未被 eventloop 取走的 publish）全部搬進 pending，重連後 next_request 優先重送 pending。mqtt.rs 的 Err 分支（109-121）只做退避，沒有清 eventloop.pending。結果：keep-alive 15 s（mqtt.rs:56）偵測窗內送出的每一則 cmd，host 已用 link-reset／timeout 標成「結果未知」（甚至 Failed，見另一項），裝置卻在重連＋1–15 s 退避後才收到並套用（原始 cmd 未到達時韌體 dedupe 幫不上忙）。這正是 protocol.rs:161-163 與 serial.rs:215-225 drain_stale_queue 明文要避免的「遲到的實體效果」。docs/acceptance-evidence.md:479 只寫「廣播前檢查與 publish 之間斷線的訊息」且稱「deadline 伸不進」——實際範圍是整個 keep-alive 偵測窗＋所有 inflight，而且 EventLoop.pending 是 pub 欄位（eventloop.rs:82），adapter 自己的 task 持有 eventloop，可直接清空。
confirmed.evidence: mqtt.rs:109-121 `Err(e) => { if connected.swap(false,..) {..} state.store(STATE_DISCONNECTED); select!{ stop | sleep(backoff) } }`（無 pending.clear()）；mqtt.rs:160-181 send 僅檢查 closed/connected 後 client.publish(QoS::AtLeastOnce)；mqtt.rs 無 send_before 實作（走 protocol.rs:164-175 預設＝立即 send）。~/.cargo/registry/src/*/rumqttc-0.24.0/src/eventloop.rs:129-136 `pub fn clean(&mut self){ self.network=None; ... self.pending.extend(self.state.clean()); let requests_in_channel = self.requests_rx.drain(); self.pending.extend(requests_in_channel); }`、:165-169 poll 的 Err 分支呼叫 self.clean()、:198-231 next_request 「prioritises pending requests from previous session」；state.rs:109-128 clean() 把 outgoing_pub（未 ack 的 QoS1/2 publish）轉成 Request::Publish；lib.rs:499 clean_session 預設 true（broker 不重播，是 client 端在重播）。tests/mqtt_loop.rs:349-411 的重連測試在閒置時被踢掉（無 inflight publish），沒有覆蓋此路徑。docs/acceptance-evidence.md:479、CHANGELOG.md:172。

verdicts.reasoning: Verified by code reading AND by a runnable reproduction against the shipped MqttRawLink. (1) rumqttc 0.24.0 (Cargo.lock) eventloop.rs: `pub pending` (L82), `clean()` L128-136 moves `state.clean()` (all un-PubAck'd QoS1 publishes, state.rs:109) plus drained channel requests into `pending`; `poll()` calls `clean()` on every select error (L165); `next_request` prioritises pending (L199). (2) crates/interaction-adapter-declarative/src/mqtt.rs (current): AsyncClient cap 16 (L64), keep-alive 15s (L60); the `Err(e)` branch (L113-125) only flips flags and backs off; the word `pending` does not appear in the file; no `send_before` override (only serial.rs:412 has one) so DeviceLink's deadline (protocol.rs:559-563) hits the trait default (protocol.rs:164-175). (3) Repro (scratchpad/mqtt_replay_repro/src/main.rs, path-dep on the real crate, fake broker that receives the QoS1 PUBLISH then drops TCP without PubAck): send() returned Ok; conn#1 received cmd id=act-1 nonce=n1 pid=2; after backoff the adapter reconnected (generation 1→2) and conn#2 received the IDENTICAL cmd again with no host call — i.e. the message had fully reached the broker, not merely "between connected-check and publish" as docs/acceptance-evidence.md:486 states, so the documented scope is understated. Host side would report LinkError::Reset "outcome UNKNOWN (not retried)" (protocol.rs:577) while the transport retries — honesty-ladder and "實體效果絕不自動重送" violations. (4) Firmware esp32-companion.ino: `who` only sendHello (L702-704), g_linkPaired[LINK_MQTT] is cleared only when the device's own MQTT drops (maintainMqtt ~L875-880), dedupe rings (L806) only catch ids/nonces that previously arrived → replayed cmd is applied. (5) Fixability: scratchpad/mqtt_replay_repro/src/bin/fix_check.rs mirrors the adapter loop with `eventloop.pending.clear()` in the Err branch → "cleared 1 pending request(s)", replayed_on_new_connection=false, reconnect still works. (6) tests/mqtt_loop.rs:349-411 kicks the adapter while idle (no inflight publish) so this path is untested. Line drift only: mqtt.rs 109→113, 56→60, 169-174→182; acceptance-evidence.md 479→486; CHANGELOG.md 172→173. Nuance: the 15 s keep-alive window applies to silent loss; TCP EOF/RST is detected immediately but still replays. Severity stays high: silent automatic re-delivery of a physical-effect command that the receipt explicitly says was not retried.

我以目前 HEAD（2e02284）親自逐段對照，反駁失敗，finding 成立：

1. rumqttc 0.24.0（Cargo.lock 鎖定）行為屬實：eventloop.rs:128-136 `clean()` 把 `state.clean()`（state.rs:109-120：所有已送出但未收到 PubAck 的 QoS1 Publish）與 `requests_rx.drain()`（尚未被 eventloop 取走的 publish）全部搬進 `pending`；poll 的 Err 分支（eventloop.rs:163-167）必呼叫 `clean()`；`next_request`（eventloop.rs:267-276）「prioritises pending requests from previous session」，重連後 ConnAck 之後第一批寫出的就是這些舊 Publish。`pending` 是 `pub` 欄位（eventloop.rs:82），adapter 自己的 task 持有 `eventloop`（mqtt.rs:64、93），可以在 Err 分支直接 `eventloop.pending.clear()`——所以「deadline 伸不進」不成立，是可修的。

2. mqtt.rs 沒有任何防護：整檔無 `pending`、無 `send_before` 覆寫（走 protocol.rs:164-175 預設＝deadline 只在送出前檢查一次，之後即交給 rumqttc 內部佇列）、無 last will、`clean_session` 用預設 true（lib.rs:499）。Err 分支（113-125）只做退避 sleep。send()（164-194）僅檢查 `connected` 旗標——而這個旗標在 socket 靜默斷掉時仍為 true，直到 rumqttc 靠 keep-alive 偵測（15 s 送 PingReq、下一個 15 s 才因 AwaitPingResp 報錯，state.rs:410-414），偵測窗最長約 30 s。

3. 誠實階梯／實體效果不重送被實際違反：host 端 ack 逾時預設 5 s（link_caps.rs:87/215、lib.rs:716）< 偵測窗，所以窗內的每則 cmd 都先被 host 標成 `LinkError::Timeout("outcome UNKNOWN (not retried: physical effects must not double-fire)")`（protocol.rs:588-590）或 `Reset`，之後 rumqttc 在退避 1–15 s 後重連並重播它們。裝置端擋不住：韌體 dedupe 只比對 cmd id／nonce 環（esp32-companion.ino:802-829），原始 cmd 從未到達所以環裡沒有；韌體的 MQTT 配對狀態只在裝置自己重連時清除（:894），`who` 不清（:702-704、:530），host 也沒設 LWT，所以裝置仍是 paired 狀態，會照常套用。DeviceLink 的重新 hello 是 lazy（protocol.rs:380-390，下一個命令才觸發），而 pending 重播在 ConnAck 後優先於任何新請求送出，握手根本來不及擋。這正是 protocol.rs:161-163 註解與 serial.rs:220-231 `drain_stale_queue` 明文要避免的「遲到的實體效果」——serial 有做，mqtt 沒做，三個 transport 對同一不變量的實作不一致。

4. 測試未覆蓋：tests/mqtt_loop.rs:349-411 的重連測試在第一個 execute 已 ack 完成後才用同 client id 踢掉連線，踢掉期間沒有任何 inflight publish，重播路徑沒被走到。

5. 已知限制寫法確實失準：docs/acceptance-evidence.md:479 與 CHANGELOG.md:172 寫「廣播前檢查與 publish 之間斷線的訊息仍可能在重連後送出」＋「deadline 伸不進」。實際範圍是「整個未偵測斷線窗（最長約 30 s）內送出的所有 cmd＋所有未 PubAck 的 inflight」，且可修。已知限制有記錄但範圍被大幅低估、並誤稱不可修，不足以覆蓋此缺陷。

嚴重度維持 high：這是實體動器在 host 已回報「結果未知」後被自動延遲重送的真實路徑，直接違反「實體效果絕不自動重送」與 serial 已實作的同一不變量，且修法是 Err 分支一行 `eventloop.pending.clear()`（或實作帶 deadline 的 send_before），成本極低。

confirmed.regressionTest: In tests/mqtt_loop.rs add a raw-TCP fake broker (or a TCP proxy in front of rumqttd) that accepts the adapter's QoS1 cmd PUBLISH and then closes the socket without PubAck; assert that after the adapter reconnects the same cmd id/nonce is never published on the new connection (fake device apply_count stays 0) and the receipt is Reset/unknown — currently fails because the cmd is re-sent on connection #2. / 在 adapter 與 in-process broker 之間放一個可黑洞化的 TCP proxy：握手＋首個 cmd 正常後把 proxy 改成只吞不轉發，執行一個新 cmd 讓 host 因無 PubAck 逾時回報 UNKNOWN，接著關閉 proxy 連線讓 adapter 退避重連，恢復轉發，再等 ≥ 退避時間，斷言 fake device 的 apply_count 沒有增加、seen_ids 不含該 cmd id（即重連後絕不重播上一世代未 ack 的 publish）。

confirmed.title: ack 逾時／BLE 途中失敗的收據永遠不會自動變 Uncertain：Dispatched 時間戳在逾時後才蓋，executor 算出 age≈0，watchdog 只做 TTL→Expired
confirmed.file: crates/interaction-adapter-declarative/src/link_caps.rs:270-278 (Timeout 分支；HEAD 2e02284 為 251-259) 與 :295-306 (Uncertain 分支)；註解 :6-7 與 :298；crates/interaction-adapter-sdk/src/lib.rs:179-184；crates/interaction-runtime/src/executor.rs:935-955；crates/interaction-runtime/src/runtime.rs:2004-2018；crates/interaction-runtime/src/activity.rs:162
confirmed.claim: link_caps.rs:5-7 宣稱「runtime watchdog 會把它誠實標為 uncertain」，實際上沒有任何路徑會做。LinkActuator::execute 在 command() 回 Timeout／Uncertain 之後才呼叫 DriverReceipt::start(&action, Utc::now()).dispatched()（link_caps.rs:253-258、277-282），DriverReceipt::dispatched 用 Utc::now()（sdk lib.rs:179-183），所以收據的 Dispatched 時間戳＝逾時結束時刻而非送出時刻；executor best-effort 驗證用「now − dispatched_at > 5000ms」判斷（executor.rs:935-956），此時 age≈0 → 什麼都不做，收據停在 Dispatched；runtime watchdog（runtime.rs:2004-2015）只把過 expires_at 的收據轉 Expired，沒有像 sweep_presentation（presentation.rs:1122-1145）那樣把逾時未 ack 的裝置動作轉 Uncertain。結果：一個裝置根本沒回 ack 的實體命令，在角色與 UI 上顯示「Working／dispatched」直到 plan TTL（policy default_ttl_ms=30000）才變 Expired；ActionUncertain 事件從未發出，CHANGELOG:144 所述「外部裝置 uncertain 進『待我決定』」對此路徑不成立。
confirmed.evidence: link_caps.rs:251-258 `Err(LinkError::Timeout(detail)) => { return Ok(DriverReceipt::start(&action, Utc::now()).dispatched().note("ackTimeout", json!(true))...) }`（在 `.await` 逾時之後才建）；crates/interaction-adapter-sdk/src/lib.rs:179-183 `pub fn dispatched(mut self){ self.receipt.transition(ActionStatus::Dispatched, Utc::now()) }`；executor.rs:935-956 `else if receipt.current_status == Dispatched { dispatched_at = timestamps.find(Dispatched) ...; if age > DEFAULT_VERIFY_TIMEOUT_MS { ...Uncertain } }`（DEFAULT_VERIFY_TIMEOUT_MS=5000，executor.rs:16）；runtime.rs:2004-2015 watchdog 僅 `if receipt.expires_at.map(|e| now > e)` → Expired；grep 全 runtime 無 ackTimeout/sendOutcomeUnknown 消費者（只有 mobile.rs:757,772 產生同樣的 note）；character.rs:408-415 ActionDispatched→(Work, Working)、ActionExpired→(Unknown, Expired)；link_caps.rs:5-7 註解宣稱 watchdog 會標 uncertain。

verdicts.reasoning:
親自重現（以目前工作樹為準；相關邏輯與 HEAD 2e02284 相同，只有行號漂移）。

靜態證據：
1. link_caps.rs:270-278 / 295-306：LinkError::Timeout 與 LinkError::Uncertain 分支都在 `.await` 回來「之後」才 `DriverReceipt::start(&action, Utc::now()).dispatched()`；sdk lib.rs:179-184 `dispatched()` 用 `Utc::now()`，所以 Dispatched 時間戳＝ack 等待結束時刻，不是送出時刻。
2. executor.rs:600-660：executor 自己的收據在呼叫 driver 前只到 Accepted，merge_driver_receipt 把 driver 的（逾時後）Dispatched 時間戳原樣搬進來；executor.rs:935-955 best-effort 驗證用 `now − dispatched_at > 5000ms` 才轉 Uncertain，此時 age≈0 → 不動。
3. runtime.rs:2004-2018 watchdog 只做 `expires_at` → Expired；character_sweep（character.rs:1391-1428）只掃 character gateway instance，不掃 link actuator 的收據；sweep_presentation 只掃 presentation bridge 的 pending。全 repo grep `ackTimeout|sendOutcomeUnknown`：runtime 內沒有任何消費者（只有 mobile.rs:757/772 與 link_caps.rs 產生註記、測試斷言註記存在）。
4. executor 的 DISPATCH_TIMEOUT_MS=10s 只在 link `timeout_ms` ≥10s 時才會先觸發 Uncertain；預設 5s（clamp 100..60000）不會。
5. activity.rs:162 只有 status=="uncertain"（非 presentation）或 "blocked" 才 needs_decision；Dispatched 與之後的 Expired 都不進「待我決定」。

動態重現（暫時性 integration test，跑完已刪除，git status 無殘留）：mock actuator 模擬 LinkActuator（sleep 400ms 後回 `dispatched()+ackTimeout`），以 `spawn_watchdog: true` 的 Runtime 執行 plan（預設 best-effort）。實測輸出：
- execute_plan 後 status=Dispatched，timestamps 顯示 Dispatched − Accepted = 402ms（即時間戳蓋在逾時後），verification=None。
- T+2.5s（watchdog 跑 2 tick）：store 仍 Dispatched，ActionUncertain 事件 0，inbox pendingCount 0。
- T+6.5s（watchdog 跑 6 tick，已超過 5s verify timeout）：仍 Dispatched，ActionUncertain 0，pendingCount 0。
- 只有手動 `verify_action`（POST /v1/actions/{id}/verify）在 >5s 後才轉 Uncertain。

結論：link_caps.rs:6-7、:298 與 CHANGELOG:271 所稱「runtime watchdog 會標 uncertain」在程式中不存在；ack 逾時／BLE 途中失敗的實體命令在角色（character.rs:408 ActionDispatched→Working）與 UI 上停在 dispatched/Working，直到 plan TTL（policy default_ttl_ms=30000）變 Expired，且 Expired 也不進「待我決定」，CHANGELOG:144「外部裝置 uncertain 進待我決定」對此路徑不成立。違反誠實階梯「結果未知要標 uncertain」。嚴重度維持 high：不涉及重送或冒充成功（安全底線仍在），但屬於已明文宣稱卻不存在的真相通報路徑，且影響所有 Serial/MQTT/BLE 與 iPhone（mobile.rs:772 同模式）實體動作。

親自逐段核對，反駁失敗，缺陷成立。完整因果鏈（全部以目前 HEAD 2e02284 檔案內容為準）：

1. 時間戳來源：link_caps.rs:230-241 先 `self.link.command(..., timeout).await`（timeout 預設 5_000ms，:214-215），等到 Err(LinkError::Timeout) 之後（:270-279）才 `DriverReceipt::start(&action, Utc::now()).dispatched()`；sdk lib.rs:179-183 `dispatched()` 固定用 `Utc::now()`。所以收據的 Dispatched 時間戳＝ack 逾時結束時刻，不是送出時刻。Uncertain 分支（:295-306）同樣。

2. 執行器端無法補救：executor.rs:656-660 `merge_driver_receipt` 以 driver 的時間戳 `base.transition(*status, *at)`（sdk lib.rs:207-214）寫入 Dispatched；:726-728 緊接著呼叫 `verify_receipt`，best-effort 分支 :935-956 用 `now − dispatched_at > DEFAULT_VERIFY_TIMEOUT_MS(5000)` 判斷，此時 age≈0ms → 不轉 Uncertain、不發 ActionUncertain；observed 分支 :817-888 亦用同一 dispatched_at 算 age，同樣≈0。executor 自身的 DISPATCH_TIMEOUT_MS=10_000（:15、:622-641）只有在 link timeout_ms 設定 >10s 時才會先觸發，預設 5s 不會。

3. 沒有任何 watchdog／sweep 會把它轉 Uncertain：runtime.rs:2004-2016 只做 `expires_at` 過期 → Expired；presentation.rs:1128-1147 `sweep_presentation_at` 只處理 `self.presentation.sweep_expired(now)` 回傳的 presentation action id；character.rs:1391-1428 `character_sweep_at` 只處理 gateway instance 心跳。全 repo grep `ackTimeout|sendOutcomeUnknown|outcomeUnknown`：唯一非產生端的引用是測試斷言與 CHANGELOG 文字，runtime 沒有任何消費者。

4. 使用者可見後果：activity.rs:161-165 `needs_decision` 只對 "uncertain"（非 presentation）與 "blocked" 為 true，"expired" 為 false → 裝置未回 ack 的實體命令永遠不進「待我決定」，CHANGELOG.md:144「外部裝置 uncertain 進待我決定」對此路徑不成立。character.rs:408/415：ActionDispatched→(Work, Working)，30s（policy.rs:119-121 default_ttl 30_000）後 ActionExpired→(Unknown, Expired)，錯誤文字為「watchdog expired the action」而非「已送出未確認」。

5. 文件與註解宣稱與事實相反：link_caps.rs:5-7、:298「runtime watchdog 會標成 uncertain」；CHANGELOG.md:270-271「ack 逾時=dispatched+ackTimeout→runtime watchdog 標 uncertain」；protocol_honesty.rs:1050-1055 斷言註解「（watchdog 會標成 uncertain）」。

6. 測試覆蓋為零：mobile_loop.rs:735-740 與 protocol_honesty.rs:1050-1055 只斷言 driver 層收據為 Dispatched＋note；crates/interaction-runtime/tests 沒有任何 link/ackTimeout 走 execute_plan 後斷言 Uncertain 的測試。前兩輪審查（080415Z-062、140445Z-042）此項皆停在 unverified，未被修復。

唯一的緩解是人工／AI 顯式呼叫 `POST /v1/actions/{id}/verify`（runtime.rs:804-817，predefault observed）且距逾時結束 >5s 才會轉 Uncertain——這是手動而非自動，finding 標題「永遠不會自動變 Uncertain」精確。此缺陷直接違反 CLAUDE.md 誠實階梯「結果未知要標 uncertain／Unknown」，發生在 v0.5 主打的 Serial／MQTT／BLE 真硬體實體效果路徑上，且文件宣稱的保護機制不存在，維持 high。

verdicts.reasoning:
以目前工作樹（HEAD 2e02284＋未提交修改）逐項親驗，主張成立。

(1) plan／agent 可讓手機顯示 emergency：`CHARACTER_STATES`（mobile.rs:131-141）含 "emergency"；`map_wire_params_titled`（mobile.rs:350-372）只對 `VERIFIED_STATE` 回 Err，其餘白名單狀態含 emergency 直接 `p.insert("state", ...)`；從 `message` 推導的分支也只排除 verified-success。我用已建好的 rlib（libinteraction_runtime-57ef88f00a959043，cargo 回報 Fresh）以 rustc 直接編譯一支獨立程式呼叫公開 API，實跑結果：`extra.state=emergency -> Ok(("character.present", {"state":"emergency"}))`、`message=emergency -> Ok(("character.present", {"state":"emergency"}))`、`extra.state=verified-success -> Err(...human-verification only...)`。執行路徑 `MobileActuator::execute`（mobile.rs:730-737）→ `map_wire_params_titled` → `bridge.act`，中間沒有其他 state 過濾；policy／executor／api 皆無針對 `iphone.character` state 的守門（grep 無結果）；desktop 端 AI 路徑有 `ai_safe_substitute`（character-protocol README:320）擋 floor intent，mobile 端沒有對等機制。iOS 端 `handleCharacterPresent`（ActuatorCenter.swift:433-441）對任何白名單 state 直接 `characterState.state = state`；CharacterView.swift:56-64 對 `.emergency` 固定顯示「緊急停止中」。

嚴重度維持 high：需要人類先啟用 `iphone.character` 並授權 desktop-pet 通道（一般使用狀態），之後 AI 即可在無 estop 時讓手機顯示固定安全文案「緊急停止中」（冒充安全狀態，違反 character-protocol README 不變量 2／5 與「AI 不得冒充安全狀態」），且真 estop 時手機角色反而不反映——兩個方向都會誤導使用者對系統是否已停止的判斷。

以目前工作樹（含未提交的 Phase 8 改動；mobile.rs 的 diff 只加了 notify 標題與 character_project_provider，未動 emergency 處理）親自驗證，finding 成立：

1. 放行路徑（實測，非僅讀碼）：在 scratchpad 建小 crate 直接呼叫 `interaction_runtime::mobile::map_wire_params("iphone.character", …)`：

confirmed.title: pendingCount 只在最近 200 筆收據／200 筆事件／500 筆候選的視窗內計算，徽章卻被註解與 UI 當成「全部待辦」
confirmed.file: crates/interaction-runtime/src/activity.rs:151 (working tree; HEAD 2e02284 is line 150) — also :99 knowledge_list(…,500), :182 events.recent(200), :276-278 「徽章代表全部待辦」註解
confirmed.claim: activity_inbox 從 `list_actions(None, 200)`（依 created_at DESC LIMIT 200）、`events.recent(200)`、`knowledge_list(candidate, 500)` 組裝；一筆較舊的 uncertain（L3 實體效果結果未知）收據一旦被 200 筆較新的收據擠出視窗，就從 pendingCount、通知徽章與「待我決定」完全消失，而不是被標示為未顯示。
confirmed.evidence: activity.rs:147 `self.list_actions(None, 200)?`、178 `self.events.recent(200)`、95 `knowledge_list(Some("candidate"), 500)`；activity.rs:252-254 註解「徽章代表全部待辦」；runtime.rs:796-802 `list_actions` → store.receipts；storage lib.rs:576 `ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT ?2`。HomePage.tsx:383、App.tsx:464 直接把 pendingCount 當總數顯示。

verdicts.reasoning: Reproduced deterministically with a throwaway integration test in crates/interaction-runtime/tests/ (run via `cargo test -p interaction-runtime --test …`, file deleted afterwards; `git status` shows no leftover). Setup: 3 older `Uncertain` receipts on a non-presentation actuator (`mock.actuator`) + newer `Completed` receipts on `conversation`. Output: with 197 newer receipts → `pendingCount=3`, `needsDecision=true` query returns 3 items; after adding 3 more (200 newer) → `pendingCount=0`, `needsDecision=true` query returns `count=0, items=0`, while `rt.list_actions(None, 1000)` still shows 203 receipts with 3 uncertain in the store. Root cause is exactly as claimed: `activity_inbox` builds from `self.list_actions(None, 200)` (activity.rs:151) → `Store::receipts` → `SELECT json FROM receipts ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT ?1` (interaction-storage/src/lib.rs:588); `created_at` comes from `receipt.timestamps.first()` (lib.rs:448-452). The new `needs_decision` filter (uncommitted working-tree diff) and the "computed before truncation" logic (activity.rs:276-281) both run AFTER the 200-window is fetched, so they cannot recover items outside it — the comment in the diff ("通知中心用這個篩選就能拿到全部待決定項，而不是從「最近 N 筆」裡碰運氣") is not true. Aggravating facts making this more than theoretical: (1) `Uncertain` is a terminal, sticky status (interaction-core/src/receipt.rs:46-57; storage `TERMINAL_STATUSES` lib.rs:438-439), `verify_receipt` returns early for terminal receipts (executor.rs:810-812), and grep finds no acknowledge/dismiss API in interaction-api/interaction-cli — so a non-L0 uncertain receipt can never leave "待我決定" except by being pushed out of the window. (2) L0 presentation acts also persist receipts (presentation.rs:1107, channel `desktop-pet`), so ordinary character activity consumes the window. (3) UI consumes `pendingCount` as the total: App.tsx:462/465 badge, HomePage.tsx:383 `pendingTotal`, and the notification panel (App.tsx:613-632 with `decisionPage`, ConnectPage.tsx:68-84) prints the affirmative "目前沒有待決定事項。" when `pendingCount=0` and no items — a false statement about undecided L3 unknown-result actions (honesty ladder: unknown must not be presented as resolved/nothing pending). No `truncated`/`windowed` flag is returned in the JSON (activity.rs:282-289). Existing test `inbox_pending_count_is_computed_before_page_truncation` (runtime_loop.rs:1060-1108) only uses 28 receipts, so the 200-window is not covered; CHANGELOG.md:144 only claims "pendingCount 在截斷前計算" and neither CHANGELOG nor docs/acceptance-evidence.md documents the window as a known limitation. Same pattern applies to `events.recent(200)` (in-memory ring, capacity 1024, no needs_decision items so lower impact) and `knowledge_list(Some("candidate"), 500)` (storage clamps to 1000; candidates are `needs_decision: true`, so >500 candidates would also undercount). Severity raised from low to medium because the count decays to an affirmative "nothing pending" with no dismissal path and no truncation signal, and it is reachable through normal use; not high because the receipts remain retrievable in history via larger `list_actions` limits and the trigger needs ≥200 newer receipts.

confirmed.regressionTest: Insert 3 Uncertain receipts on a non-presentation actuator, then 200 newer Completed receipts; assert `activity_inbox(default)["pendingCount"] == 3` and that `ActivityInboxFilter{needs_decision: Some(true)}` returns those 3 items (or, at minimum, that the response carries an explicit truncation/window flag when the count is not exhaustive).

confirmed.title: LinkError::Reset（等待中重連，結果未知）被寫成 Failed 終態：對未知結果宣稱確定失敗，誘發重試
confirmed.file: crates/interaction-adapter-declarative/src/link_caps.rs:313 (Reset arm spans 306-315; drifted from 284-293 because uncommitted parallel edits inserted refusal_reason()/STOP_ALL_ACK_WINDOW above it — the arm itself is unchanged). Test: crates/interaction-adapter-declarative/tests/protocol_honesty.rs:845-851 (unchanged).
confirmed.claim: protocol.rs:576-578 明確把 Reset 描述為「outcome UNKNOWN (not retried)」，link_caps.rs:284-293 卻把它做成 `.dispatched()…failed("link-reset")`，收據 current_status=Failed（終態），只在 driver_response 放 outcomeUnknown 註記；runtime 對 Failed 發 ActionFailed，角色投影成 TruthState::Failed（character.rs:413），UI／AI 看到的是「失敗」而非「未知」。與同一函式對 Timeout（→Dispatched＋ackTimeout）與 Uncertain（→Dispatched＋sendOutcomeUnknown）的處理自相矛盾。Failed 會讓人或 AI 合理地重下同一命令；而在 MQTT 場景（見 rumqttc pending 一項）原命令會在重連後被重送並套用，重試＝雙重實體效果。違反規格 §2「外部動作結果未知不得顯示成功，也不得自動重試」與誠實階梯「未知要標 uncertain」。
confirmed.evidence: link_caps.rs:284-293 `Err(LinkError::Reset(detail)) => { return Ok(DriverReceipt::start(&action, Utc::now()).dispatched().note("transport",..).note("outcomeUnknown", json!(true)).failed("link-reset", &detail).finish()); }`；protocol.rs:576-578 `LinkError::Reset(format!("link reset (reconnected) while waiting for action {action_id} — outcome UNKNOWN (not retried)"))`；character.rs:413 `EventType::ActionFailed => (I::Failed, T::Failed)`；tests/protocol_honesty.rs:845-851 目前把 Failed 當成期望值固定下來。

verdicts.reasoning: Reproduced. link_caps.rs:306-315 handles `LinkError::Reset` with `.dispatched().note("outcomeUnknown", true).failed("link-reset", &detail)`; `DriverReceipt::failed` (interaction-adapter-sdk/src/lib.rs:193-198) transitions the receipt to ActionStatus::Failed, a terminal state (interaction-core/src/receipt.rs:46-52). Running `cargo test -p interaction-adapter-declarative --test protocol_honesty a_reconnect_ends_the_waiting_command_as_link_reset` passes and pins Failed as the expected value (protocol_honesty.rs:845-851). The code itself concedes the outcome is unknown three times: the arm's comment ("命令可能已到裝置，結果未知"), the LinkError::Reset doc (protocol.rs:124-126 "結果未知"), and the error text (protocol.rs:576-578 "outcome UNKNOWN (not retried)"). In the same match, Timeout (270-278) and Uncertain (295-304) — the same epistemic state (sent, no ack) — return Dispatched without failed(), so the Reset arm is internally inconsistent. Downstream, nothing reads the `outcomeUnknown` note (grep over all .rs/.ts/.tsx/.swift: only producers in link_caps.rs/mobile.rs and test asserts), so the Failed status is what everyone sees: executor.rs:691-693 emits ActionFailed; character.rs:413 projects it to TruthState::Failed; the desktop label is "失敗" rather than "結果未知" (appstate.tsx:227-230); the "不會自動重試，以免重複執行" hint renders only for uncertain (ActivityPage.tsx:101-105); and the decision Inbox marks needs_decision only for "uncertain"/"blocked" (activity.rs:159-163), so a reset-during-wait — where a physical command may already have been applied — never enters 「待我決定」, unlike the Timeout case. That violates the honesty-ladder invariant "結果未知要標 uncertain／Unknown". Two parts of the claim are overstated and I do not count them: (1) there is no in-system automatic retry on Failed (no retry/on_failure logic in recipe/executor/runtime), so spec line 53's literal "不得顯示成功／不得自動重試" is not breached — the harm is a human/AI reasonably re-issuing a "failed" command (skill guidance at SKILL.md:58 only tells agents to respect `uncertain`, not `failed`); (2) the MQTT re-delivery double-effect chain is a separate finding and was not verified here. Note the driver cannot emit Uncertain directly (merge_driver_receipt only accepts Dispatched/Acknowledged/Failed), which likely explains the choice, but the Timeout arm demonstrates the honest alternative. Severity stays medium: core honesty invariant, real UI/Inbox/character consequences, no automatic physical double-fire on its own.

confirmed.regressionTest: With a mock RawLink that bumps generation while a cmd awaits ack, assert the LinkActuator receipt is NOT ActionStatus::Failed (Dispatched + outcomeUnknown, or after runtime merge, Uncertain), that the runtime Inbox lists the action with needs_decision=true, and that the cmd was written exactly once.

1. Structural claim holds. `grep state\.store` in ble.rs yields exactly four writers: 222 (connect() success → CONNECTED), 249 and 258 (ensure_open: is_connected()==false or connect() failure → DISCONNECTED), 325 (shutdown → CLOSED). `connected()` at 303-307 and `link_state()` at 309-319 only read the atomic. So on GATT disconnect the stream does not end at all — the notify task at ble.rs:210-220 parks forever rather than "quietly exits". 3. Contrast with sibling transports: serial.rs:300/327 and mqtt.rs:113-119 flip state to DISCONNECTED from their I/O loops. BLE is the only transport whose health cannot change without a caller.

4. Consumer chain confirmed: protocol.rs:334-348 `readiness()` is a pure read of `raw.link_state()`; link_caps.rs:116-131 maps Ready→`ComponentHealth::healthy()`; link_caps.rs:327-335 `status()` and :106-108 `health()` call it; registry lib.rs:299-335 `refresh_health` caches it and `availability_of` (369-375) yields Available; runtime.rs:2028-2030 refreshes every 10 ticks with default `watchdog_interval_ms = 1_000` (config.rs:52) → every ~10 s it re-reads the stale flag. 5. Only recovery is `ensure_open` via `ensure_ready` (protocol.rs:381) / `read_state` (protocol.rs:679), i.e. the next dispatch or read. No periodic receptor polling exists in the runtime tick task, so the finding's "actuator-only adapter" scoping is actually conservative: any idle BLE adapter shows healthy indefinitely after the peripheral leaves range.

6. Not already fixed / not documented: docs/acceptance-evidence.md and CHANGELOG.md only carry the generic "real BLE unverified" caveat, nothing about stale health. Receipt/audit cannot attribute the device: `dispatch` (559-579) returns only `oneshot::Receiver<Value>` and keeps device_id inside `PendingAct` (412-416); `act` (598-604) returns just the reply Value; `MobileActuator::execute` (738-752) builds the receipt with only `.note("transport","mobile-wss")` and `.note("deviceApplied", …)`. `ActionReceipt` (interaction-core/src/receipt.rs:94-120) has `actuator_id` (shared "iphone.haptic") and no provider/device field. mobile.rs has no audit call on act execution (audits are server-started/pairing/revoke/etc.), and executor.rs only audits "action.blocked". So after a torch/haptic on a two-phone setup nothing in receipts, events, or audit says which phone.

3. Descriptor vs registry mismatch: `mobile_register_provider` (1375-1400) creates `provider.mobile.{device_id}` per phone with `actuators: MOBILE_ACTUATORS…` (all 6), while `mobile_register_capabilities` (1030-1093) is called once from `mobile_ensure_started` (line 1002) and registers a single shared `MobileActuator` per id (`let _ = self.registry.register_actuator(actuator).await;` at 1090). Minor correction to the claim: the `let _` is a one-time server-start registration, not a per-device duplicate being swallowed — but the substantive point (one shared actuator set behind N per-device descriptors) holds.

4. Additional consequence found while verifying (static trace, not live-run since no files may be written): executor.rs:678-688 on Acknowledged calls `note_capability_tested(Actuator, "iphone.haptic")` → providers.rs:436-447 `provider_of_capability` does `providers.list().find(|p| p.actuators.contains(id))` — first provider in BTreeMap order regardless of state. Disconnected mobile providers remain registered (mobile.rs:1756-1776 transitions to Disconnected, never removes). So with phone A (lexicographically first) paired-but-disconnected and phone B connected, B's ack records「已測試」evidence on provider A, which never received the command — an honesty misattribution beyond the claim's scope.

5. Not documented as a known limitation: grep for 多台/兩台/多支/多部/一台/multi-device/single iPhone across CHANGELOG.md, docs/acceptance-evidence.md, docs/FEATURES.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, README returns nothing relevant (only mobile.rs:179 about multiple computers). Spec §10.1 requires「每台 iPhone 獨立金鑰」and models each phone as its own provider. No test covers two paired phones: mobile_loop.rs's only second connection is the unauthenticated impostor at 709-747.

Severity stays medium: receipts do not lie (acknowledged is true for whichever phone acked) and effects remain policy-bounded, but a physical effect on one of several phones is unattributable and unselectable, and tested-evidence can land on the wrong provider.

confirmed.title: command() 把等待期間任何無 id 的 err 當成本次結果：平行步驟共用同一裝置時可能把已套用的命令誤標為 device-refused
confirmed.file: crates/interaction-adapter-declarative/src/protocol.rs:571 (unchanged); crates/interaction-runtime/src/executor.rs:288 (tokio::spawn per step, default mode "parallel" at :253); crates/interaction-adapter-declarative/src/lib.rs:1043 (shared link reuse); crates/interaction-adapter-declarative/src/link_caps.rs:259-264 (Err → failed("device-refused")); firmware line numbers drifted: esp32-companion.ino:690 bad-json, :695 unknown-type, :847 serial overflow, :867 mqtt ≥640, :957-958 BLE too-long/busy (finding cited :659/:664/:798/:818/:908-909)
confirmed.claim: wait_reply 的 pick 對 `DeviceMsg::Err { id: None, .. }` 無條件回 Some，且多個 command() 可同時在同一 DeviceLink 上等待（executor 對 parallel 模式的每個 step tokio::spawn，同一 adapter 的 led/vibe/buzzer 動器共用一條 link）。韌體對無法解析或過長的輸入回無 id 的 err（bad-json／unknown-type／BLE busy）；當 cmd A 已被裝置套用（ack 稍後才到）而另一則訊息 B 引發匿名 err，A 的等待者會先吃到 B 的 err，收據寫成 failed(device-refused)，A 的真 ack 之後被丟棄；人或 AI 依「失敗」重送 A＝重複實體效果。參考韌體只在畸形／過長輸入時發匿名 err，所以觸發需要 params 帶長 message 或 BLE 佇列滿，機率低，但錯配邏輯本身確定存在。
confirmed.evidence: protocol.rs:564-573 `wait_reply(..., |m| match m { Ack{id:Some(id),..} if id==action_id => Some, Err{id:Some(id),..} if id==action_id => Some, DeviceMsg::Err { id: None, .. } => Some(m.clone()), _ => None })`；executor.rs:281-292 parallel 模式每 step `tokio::spawn(run_step)`；lib.rs:980-1063 同一 adapter 的所有 serial capability 共用一條 DeviceLink；firmware esp32-companion.ino:659 `sendErr(link, nullptr, "bad-json")`、:664 unknown-type、:798 serial 行溢位、:818 mqtt ≥640 bytes、:908-909 BLE too-long/busy 皆無 id。

verdicts.reasoning:
主張成立，且可重現（模擬器層級，非真機）。

證據：
1. protocol.rs:564-573 `command()` 的 pick 對 `DeviceMsg::Err { id: None, .. }` 無條件回 Some（:571），註解明寫「等待期間收到就是這次請求的結果」——此假設只在「每條 link 同時只有一個 in-flight 請求」時成立，但 DeviceLink 沒有任何 per-command 序列化（struct :297-308 只有握手用 `handshaken` mutex；link_caps.rs 只有 `recent` 記錄用 Mutex，無 in-flight gate）。
2. executor.rs:253 預設 actuationMode="parallel"，:288 對每個 step `tokio::spawn(run_step)`；`actuator.execute` 在 :606 `drop(authorization_guard)` 之後、無任何 per-actuator 鎖下呼叫（:622-625）。lib.rs:985-1059 同一 adapter 的所有 serial/mqtt/ble capability 共用一個 `Arc<DeviceLink>`（:1043 `link.clone()` 重用）。故同一 link 上並行 command() 是真實路徑。
3. link_caps.rs:259-264：`Ok(DeviceMsg::Err { reason, .. })` 一律寫成 `.failed("device-refused", &reason)`。
4. 我在 scratchpad 寫最小重現（/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-user-Workspace-claude-lab-adaptive-interaction/a0f21e4d-b75c-47b2-abed-618b5f97d701/scratchpad/anonerr-repro/tests/repro.rs，用 path dependency 引用真實 crate，不改 repo）：mock 裝置對 cmd B 40ms 後回 `err{id:None,"busy"}`、對 cmd A 120ms 後回 `ack{id:"A"}`；先 spawn B、5ms 後 spawn A。結果 `A result = Ok(Err { id: None, reason: "busy" })`、`device emitted acks = 1`——A 已被裝置套用並 ack，主機卻回 device-refused；A 的真 ack 無人接收。對照組（同樣訊息、循序送）A 正確拿到自己的 ack。2 tests passed。
5. 韌體匿名 err 站點確實存在（行號已漂移，見 corrected_file_line）；BLE 路徑尤其明確：drainBleQueue（:957-958）在處理佇列內任何 cmd 之前先送出無 id 的 busy/bad-json，因此所有已排入佇列、隨後會被套用並 ack 的命令，其等待者都會先吃到匿名 err → 全部誤標 device-refused。

對 finding 的修正：「params 帶長 message」不是可行觸發——主機端在送線前就拒絕超長訊息（serial.rs:360 MAX_LINE_BYTES=639、mqtt.rs:173、ble.rs:271 MAX_WRITE_BYTES=480），bad-json/unknown-type/空 id 也不會由主機產生。以參考韌體＋現行主機而言，實際觸發只剩 BLE 8 槽入站佇列溢位（韌體 loop 停頓時，例如 MQTT 重連阻塞期間），以及第三方依協定 v1 實作、較自由發匿名 err 的裝置。機率低，與原判 low 一致。

不變量影響：收據把「已套用」寫成 failed(device-refused)——誠實階梯的反向錯誤（假失敗）；韌體 dedupe 只擋同 id/nonce 重放，人或 AI 依失敗收據重下新 action 即為重複實體效果。系統本身不自動重送（符合不變量），但收據內容錯誤。

confirmed.regressionTest: 用 MockRawLink 在同一 DeviceLink 上並行兩個 command()（B 先、A 後），mock 對 B 回無 id 的 err、對 A 稍後回 ack{id:A}；斷言 A 不得被回報為 Err(device-refused)（應拿到自己的 ack，或在多個 in-flight 請求時把匿名 err 誠實記為 Uncertain 而非歸給任一請求），且 A 的 ack 不得被丟棄。

verdicts.reasoning:
事實部分屬實但結論不成立——這不是 exec fallback 這條路徑的缺陷，而是 runtime 跨 connector 的既定、且有回歸測試釘住的設計。

1. 行為並非 exec fallback 特有。Codex app-server 路徑同樣把 turn/interrupt → `turn.status=interrupted` 映成 `GatewayEvent::TaskCancelled`（crates/interaction-agent-gateway/src/codex.rs:518，註解明寫「誠實階梯：中斷是 cancelled」），runtime 事件泵統一報 "cancelled"（crates/interaction-runtime/src/gateway.rs:500-505）→ `AgentSessionState::Cancelled`（agents.rs:876），`is_open()` 對 Cancelled 為 false（interaction-core/src/agent.rs:48-57）。exec fallback 只是把同一語意套到「每 turn 一個子程序」的模型上。

2. 這個語意被明確的回歸測試釘死：crates/interaction-runtime/tests/gateway_loop.rs:1656 `an_interrupted_codex_turn_is_cancelled_not_claimed_completed` 在 `gateway_interrupt` 後斷言 state==Cancelled、`!record.state.is_open()`、`claim_id.is_none()`，並斷言之後 `close_agent_session(..,"closed")` 仍可執行且保留 Cancelled（`closed (was Cancelled)`）。我在目前樹上實跑：`cargo test -p interaction-runtime --test gateway_loop an_interrupted_codex_turn_is_cancelled_not_claimed_completed` → 1 passed。finding 所述「一次中斷 → 不再 open → mailbox closed」正是測試要求的行為。

3. 「不走 close 收尾」是所有 report 造成的任務結局（Failed／Unknown／TimedOut／Cancelled）的共同設計，不是 interrupt 特例：agents.rs close_agent_session 註解明寫「report 造成的 Failed/TimedOut/Cancelled 是『任務結局』，仍需要 close 來收尾（清 consent、關 provider、記經驗）」，且 closed_at 未設時 close 仍被接受。interrupt 與 cancel／close 在 API 上確實是三個不同操作（/interrupt 只送 SIGINT／turn/interrupt、不設 closed_at、不清 consent；/close 才收尾），符合 spec §8.3「建立、續租、取消、interrupt、close、resume」的列舉；spec 並未規定中斷後 session 必須仍可再交代。

4. 產品上並非「無法再交代」：AiPage.tsx:531-556 對 `!open && providerSessionId` 顯示「接續上次（唯讀）」，exec fallback 在 thread.started 後即持有 providerSessionId（codex_exec.rs:197-201），中斷後可沿 thread 續開新 session。

5. 「看門狗 record-closed 殺掉已結束程序群」對 exec fallback 是無害 no-op：reader task 結束時 `group.clear_if(spawned_pgid)`（codex_exec.rs:243），`ProcessGroup::terminate` 在 pgid 為 None 時直接返回（process.rs:145-147）。

因此 finding 實為對「interrupt 是否應保持 session open」的設計異議，且與既有測試的明示意圖相反，不構成可驗證缺陷。
